patterns.action: Overwrite existing file (write_file to a path that already exists)
patterns.easy_win: Before write_file, read original bytes and cp to .chats-sandbox/backups/<sanitized-path>/<ISO-timestamp>.bak; reversal: cp .bak back to original path, rm .bak
patterns.verify_note: cp snapshot captured 'original content v1'; overwrite changed it; cp .bak back restored exact bytes; confirmed by re-read

patterns.action: Truncate or partially overwrite a file (write_file with empty or shorter content)
patterns.easy_win: Identical snapshot path as full overwrite: cp pre-write bytes to .chats-sandbox/backups/<sanitized-path>/<ISO-timestamp>.bak; reversal: cp .bak back
patterns.applies_to: write_file with empty or shorter payload
patterns.verify_note: 5-line file truncated to 0 bytes; cp .bak restored all 5 lines exactly; one code path handles both overwrite cases

patterns.action: Create a new file (write_file to a path that did not previously exist)
patterns.easy_win: Write sentinel .chats-sandbox/backups/<sanitized-path>/<ISO-timestamp>.created containing only the original path; reversal: mv created file to <ISO-timestamp>.deleted (trash), rm sentinel
patterns.applies_to: write_file where destination path was absent before the call
patterns.verify_note: sentinel recorded path; after creation, reversal mv'd file to .deleted and rm'd sentinel; original path absent on re-check

patterns.action: Move or rename a file (move_file, destination does not exist)
patterns.easy_win: Append JSON entry {from, to, ts} to .chats-sandbox/backups/move-log.jsonl; reversal: parse entry, call move_file(to, from)
patterns.applies_to: move_file where destination path did not previously exist
patterns.verify_note: log entry written; mv src->dst; reverse mv dst->src restored file with original content intact; no copy needed

patterns.action: Move file onto an existing destination (move_file where destination path already holds a file, clobbering it)
patterns.easy_win: Snapshot destination to .chats-sandbox/backups/<sanitized-dst-path>/<ISO-timestamp>.bak before move; record move-log entry; reversal: (1) move_file(dst,src), (2) cp .bak back to dst
patterns.applies_to: move_file where destination path already exists
patterns.verify_note: dst snapshotted; mv clobbered dst; reversal restored src via mv and dst via cp .bak; both files verified with original content

patterns.action: Move a file out of a tracked directory (effectively removing it from a watched scope)
patterns.easy_win: Same move-log entry {from, to, ts} as plain move; reversal: move_file(to, from); no bytes copied, original content/permissions/mtime survive intact
patterns.applies_to: move_file where source is inside a watched/tracked directory scope
patterns.verify_note: file moved from chats_probe_p6_tracked/ to outside path; reverse mv restored it to original directory path; content identical, zero-copy cost
